channel.title: GitHub Rust Languages Daily Trending
channel.description: Daily Trending of Rust Languages in GitHub

item.title: akitaonrails / ai-memory
item.description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors

item.title: xerj-org / xerj
item.description: Local-first search engine and MCP server for AI agents. One Rust binary indexes code, docs, logs, JSONL/CSV and PDFs for BM25 full-text, vector and hybrid search, code search without grep, agent memory and RAG. Elasticsearch-compatible API; Corpus Hub serves hundreds of reference memory corpora.

item.title: oven-sh / bun
item.description: Incredibly fast JavaScript runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager – all in one

item.title: ZSeven-W / openpencil
item.description: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool and the first to feature concurrent Agent Teams. Design-as-Code. Turn prompts into UI directly on the live canvas. A modern alternative to Pencil.

item.title: mixelpixx / Konnect
item.description: AI-assisted PCB design for KiCAD 10. Native KiCAD plugin — a single Rust binary exposing 217 schematic, layout, routing, placement, design-review, and manufacturing tools to Claude, or the LLM of your choosing

item.title: leepokai / Codync
item.description: Bring your own agent and subscription: message Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot and 40+ AI agents as bots on your own computer, from iPhone, Mac, Windows, Linux or terminal. Agent-agnostic, free, open source. The Grok Bot, Muse and Dots alternative. Built in Rust.

item.title: macro-inc / macro
item.description: Macro is a unified workspace for teams: email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM — @-linked together with shared AI memory.

item.description: Offline, privacy-first grammar checker. Fast, open-source, Rust-powered
